howto.name: Convert and download
howto.text: Click Convert. The uncompressed BMP is re-encoded as a JPEG — typically 10–50× smaller for photographs.

faq.a: BMP files are uncompressed and can be 10–50× larger than the same image as JPG. Converting saves enormous space with virtually no visible quality difference for photos.
For screenshots and pixel art, consider BMP to PNG instead — PNG is lossless and handles sharp edges better than JPG.
Yes. All standard BMP variants (1-bit, 4-bit, 8-bit, 16-bit, 24-bit, 32-bit, RLE-compressed) are supported.
